author: 杜牧
text: 多情却似总无情，唯觉尊前笑不成。蜡烛有心还惜别，替人垂泪到天明。

semantic_units.semantic_content: 深情与似无情的悖论张力
semantic_units.must_preserve: 同时保留'深情'和'似无情'两个对立面，以及它们之间的悖论关系
pass_conditions: 译文同时提到'深情/deep love/affection'和'似无情/seeming coldness/indifference'
保留了二者之间的对立/矛盾/张力，不能flatten为简单陈述
good_examples: love so deep it seems like none
deep affection appearing as indifference
passion masked as coldness
bad_examples: passionate but passionless (字面翻译，丢失张力)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 在酒席前笑不出来的状态
semantic_units.must_preserve: 无法笑出的情感状态，不是不想笑
pass_conditions: 译文表达'无法/不能笑出'（unable to/cannot），不是'不想笑'
保留'尊前/at the table/at the farewell wine'的场景
good_examples: unable to smile at the table
find myself unable to smile at the farewell wine
cannot manage a smile
bad_examples: don't want to laugh (改变情感，变成主动不愿)
only feel cannot laugh (语法错误)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 蜡烛的拟人化（有心惜别）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 蜡烛作为拟人主体，仿佛有心在惋惜离别
pass_conditions: 译文明确蜡烛是拟人主体（candle似乎有心/有感情）
保留拟人的修辞效果，不能削弱为简单形容
good_examples: the candle seems to share the sorrow of parting
even the candle grieves the parting
the candle has a heart to mourn
bad_examples: the sad candle (削弱拟人，变成形容词)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 蜡烛替人流泪 + 一直到天明
semantic_units.must_preserve: '替人'的关系（蜡烛代替人流泪）+ '到天明'的时间延续
pass_conditions: 译文明确'替人/for us/on our behalf'的代替关系
保留'到天明/until dawn/till morning'的时间延续
good_examples: weeps for us until dawn
sheds tears on our behalf till morning
cries in our stead until daybreak
bad_examples: people and candle cry together (改变'替人'关系)

author: 王维
text: 红豆生南国，春来发几枝。愿君多采撷，此物最相思。

semantic_units.semantic_content: 红豆作为相思的象征（借代）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 红豆不只是植物，而是相思之情的象征
pass_conditions: 译文保留'红豆'作为特定意象
或明确指出其象征意义
good_examples: red beans (lovesickness beans)
red beans that symbolize longing
the red bean of yearning

semantic_units.must_preserve: 劝说/希望的语气，主语是'君'
pass_conditions: 译文表达希望/劝说的语气（wish/hope/may）
good_examples: I wish you would gather more
may you pluck them often
I hope you will pick many
bad_examples: many are picked (被动，丢失主语)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 此物最能寄托相思之情
semantic_units.must_preserve: 物作为情感寄托，不是物本身会思念
pass_conditions: 译文表达'这个东西最能象征/寄托相思'
good_examples: these most embody yearning
this thing best conveys longing
these beans speak most of love
bad_examples: this thing misses (物作为思念主体)
most lovesick thing (形容词化，意义模糊)
they think of you (改变意义)

semantic_units.must_preserve: 自然生长的场景，疑问语气
good_examples: in spring they sprout a few branches
when spring comes, how many branches grow
spring brings forth several sprigs
bad_examples: cut branches in spring (改变动作)

author: 李商隐
text: 君问归期未有期，巴山夜雨涨秋池。何当共剪西窗烛，却话巴山夜雨时。

semantic_units.must_preserve: 不是'没有期限'，而是'还没有确定的日期'
pass_conditions: 译文表达'尚未确定/cannot yet be set'
good_examples: you ask when I'll return, but the date is still uncertain
the return date cannot yet be determined
no date has been set for my return
bad_examples: no deadline for return (误解为无期限)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 什么时候能一起剪西窗烛（未来假设）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 将来时态，期待的假设情境
pass_conditions: 译文使用将来时态（when will/when can）
good_examples: when can we trim the candle by the western window together
when will we sit together trimming the wick
someday we'll trim the candle at the western window
bad_examples: we trimmed the candle (过去时，时态错误)
we are trimming (现在时，时态错误)
trim the candle now (命令式，错误)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 那时回忆讲述今夜巴山雨
semantic_units.must_preserve: 将来回忆现在，时态复杂
pass_conditions: 译文体现'将来回忆过去'的时态
good_examples: and talk about tonight's rain in Ba mountains
reminiscing about this rainy night
speak of this very rain we're hearing now
bad_examples: talk about future rain (时间错误)

semantic_units.must_preserve: 夜雨和涨水的因果关系
pass_conditions: 译文表达雨使池水上涨
保留巴山、夜雨、秋池三个意象
good_examples: night rain on Ba mountains swells the autumn pools
the autumn pond rises with Ba mountain's rain
Ba mountain rain fills the autumn pool
bad_examples: Ba mountain is wet (简化过度)

author: 秦观
text: 两情若是久长时，又岂在朝朝暮暮。

semantic_units.semantic_content: 如果两人情感长久（条件假设）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 条件假设的语气
pass_conditions: 译文使用条件句（if/as long as）
good_examples: if the two hearts last long
as long as love endures
when feelings are lasting
bad_examples: two hearts are long (陈述事实)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 又何必在乎日日相守（反问）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 反问语气，意为'不必在于'
pass_conditions: 译文表达反问或否定意义
good_examples: why need we be together every day
it need not be day and night together
does it matter if we're not together daily
bad_examples: must be together daily (肯定，反义)
they meet every day (陈述事实)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 日日夜夜、时时刻刻相守
semantic_units.must_preserve: 持续相守的状态
good_examples: day and night together
every morning and evening
being together all the time

semantic_units.semantic_content: 条件与反问的逻辑关系
semantic_units.must_preserve: 如果长久，就不必日日相守的逻辑
pass_conditions: 译文体现条件-结论的逻辑
good_examples: if love lasts, we need not be together daily
lasting love doesn't require constant togetherness
as long as hearts endure, daily meetings don't matter
bad_examples: love and daily meetings (并列无逻辑)
long love needs daily meetings (逻辑相反)

author: 李清照
text: 寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚。

semantic_units.must_preserve: 叠词的重复感，持续寻找
pass_conditions: 译文表达重复或持续的寻找
保留叠词的韵律感（可用repetition体现）
good_examples: searching and searching
seeking, seeking
searching here and there

semantic_units.must_preserve: 从动作转到环境描写
pass_conditions: 译文表达冷清、寂寥的环境
good_examples: cold and desolate
bleak and lonely
chill and empty

semantic_units.must_preserve: 情感的递进和加深
good_examples: miserable, wretched, sorrowful
grief upon grief
overwhelming sadness

semantic_units.semantic_content: 从动作→环境→情绪的递进结构
semantic_units.must_preserve: 三个层次的递进关系
pass_conditions: 译文体现动作、环境、情绪的层次
good_examples: searching...cold...sorrowful (保持层次)
action→environment→emotion structure preserved
bad_examples: sad while searching in cold (混为一谈)

author: 孟浩然
text: 春眠不觉晓，处处闻啼鸟。夜来风雨声，花落知多少。

semantic_units.semantic_content: 不知道花落了多少（主语是'我'）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 主语是说话人'我'，不是'花'
pass_conditions: 译文主语是'I/我'或隐含的观察者
good_examples: I wonder how many flowers have fallen
how many blossoms fell, who knows
the fallen flowers, how many can there be
bad_examples: flowers know how much they fell (主语是花)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 春天睡眠沉，不知道天亮
semantic_units.must_preserve: 睡过头，没察觉天亮
pass_conditions: 译文表达睡眠和未察觉
good_examples: in spring I sleep unaware of dawn
spring slumber, not noticing daybreak
sleeping through the spring morning

semantic_units.must_preserve: '到处'的范围和'闻'的听觉
good_examples: everywhere I hear birds singing
birdsong all around
birds chirping here and there

semantic_units.must_preserve: 过去时态，听觉
pass_conditions: 译文表达过去的时间（夜来=昨夜）
good_examples: last night's wind and rain
sounds of storm through the night
wind and rain came in the night

author: 刘禹锡
text: 朱雀桥边野草花，乌衣巷口夕阳斜。旧时王谢堂前燕，飞入寻常百姓家。

semantic_units.semantic_content: 东晋王氏谢氏世家（专名，不可泛化）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 保留专名，不能泛化为'富贵人家'
good_examples: the Wang and Xie aristocratic families
Wang and Xie mansions
noble houses of Wang and Xie

semantic_units.semantic_content: 昔日豪门→如今平民，盛衰对比
semantic_units.must_preserve: 时间对比和社会阶层对比
pass_conditions: 译文体现'昔日vs如今'的时间对比
体现'豪门vs百姓'的阶层对比
good_examples: swallows from old noble halls now fly to common homes
once at aristocratic doorsteps, now at ordinary homes
from grand estates of old to humble dwellings now

semantic_units.must_preserve: 燕子不是主角，是见证盛衰的意象
pass_conditions: 不是'同一只燕子活了数百年'
good_examples: the swallows that once knew those halls
swallows (as witnesses to change)
swallows that frequent these eaves
bad_examples: the same swallow lived 400 years (字面误读)

semantic_units.must_preserve: 衰败、荒凉的氛围
good_examples: wild grass and flowers, slanting sunset
weeds bloom, the sun sets low
overgrown and bathed in evening light

author: 王维
text: 空山不见人，但闻人语响。返景入深林，复照青苔上。

semantic_units.semantic_content: 看不见人，但听得见说话声
semantic_units.must_preserve: 视觉与听觉的对比
pass_conditions: 译文明确'看不见'和'听得见'的对比
good_examples: see no one, yet hear voices
no people visible, but their voices heard
unseen but their speech echoes
bad_examples: no people at all (完全没人)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 夕阳返照进入深林（动态）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 光线移动的动态感
good_examples: returning light enters the deep forest
reflected sunbeams penetrate the woods
evening rays reach into the depths

semantic_units.must_preserve: '复'的再次、又一次
good_examples: and further shines upon the moss
again illuminates the green moss
lighting up the mossy ground

semantic_units.must_preserve: 不是'没有山'，是'空旷的山'
good_examples: in the empty mountain
the deserted hills
the quiet mountain

author: 张继
text: 月落乌啼霜满天，江枫渔火对愁眠。

semantic_units.semantic_content: 三个意象并列（不是因果）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 月落、乌啼、霜满天是并列的画面
good_examples: moon sets, crows cry, frost fills the sky
moonfall, crow calls, and frost everywhere
the moon descends, ravens call, frost covers all
bad_examples: moon sets so crows cry (因果)

semantic_units.must_preserve: '对'是面对，'愁'修饰'眠'
good_examples: facing sorrow, I sleep
lie sleepless with worry
sleep troubled by grief

semantic_units.semantic_content: 江边枫树和渔火（两个意象）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 江枫和渔火两个并列意象
good_examples: river maples and fishing lights
riverside maples, fishermen's fires
maple trees by the river, lanterns of fishing boats

semantic_units.must_preserve: 凄清、孤寂的整体氛围
good_examples: desolate night scene
lonely and melancholic atmosphere
bleakness of night mooring

author: 白居易
text: 野火烧不尽，春风吹又生。

semantic_units.must_preserve: 否定意义，火烧不完草
good_examples: wildfire cannot burn them all
the flames fail to destroy them completely
fire burns but cannot finish them

semantic_units.must_preserve: 再生、重生的意义
good_examples: spring breeze blows, they grow again
with spring wind they revive
the spring wind brings them back to life

semantic_units.must_preserve: 火作为施动者，草作为受动者
pass_conditions: 译文明确火烧草的关系
good_examples: wildfire attacks the grass
flames assault the vegetation
fire tries to consume them

semantic_units.must_preserve: 生命力旺盛、不屈不挠的主题
good_examples: resilient life force
indomitable vitality
the grass's tenacity

author: 李白
text: 床前明月光，疑是地上霜。举头望明月，低头思故乡。

semantic_units.semantic_content: 怀疑是地上的霜（推测，不确定）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 推测、不确定的语气
good_examples: I suspect it's frost on the ground
wondering if it's frost below
it seems like frost on the floor

semantic_units.chinese: 举头望明月，低头思故乡
semantic_units.must_preserve: 两个动作的因果或顺承关系
good_examples: I raise my head to gaze at the moon, then lower it, homesick
looking up at the moon, looking down missing home
the moon reminds me, head bowed, of home
bad_examples: think of home while looking at sun (改变对象)
only look at moon (丢失思乡)

semantic_units.must_preserve: 月光的明亮和位置
good_examples: bright moonlight before my bed
moonbeams at my bedside
moonlight shining by my bed

semantic_units.must_preserve: 宁静、独处、思乡的氛围
good_examples: quiet solitude and homesickness
peaceful night, lonely thoughts
silent contemplation of home

author: 王之涣
text: 白日依山尽，黄河入海流。欲穷千里目，更上一层楼。

semantic_units.semantic_content: 想要看尽千里（目的、愿望）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 目的、愿望的语气
pass_conditions: 译文使用表目的的词（to/want to/wish to）
good_examples: to see a thousand miles
wishing to exhaust the view of a thousand li
wanting to take in the distant vista
bad_examples: can see far (已经能看，无目的)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 需要再上一层楼（条件、手段）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 手段、条件的关系
pass_conditions: 译文体现'需要/必须'再上一层
与前句形成目的-手段关系
good_examples: one must climb another floor
I need to ascend one more story
requires going up another level
bad_examples: already on top floor (无需再上)

semantic_units.must_preserve: 要达到目的，需要采取手段
pass_conditions: 译文明确逻辑：想看远→需上楼
good_examples: to see far, I must climb higher
wanting to see more requires ascending
greater height brings greater vision
bad_examples: climb for other reason (目的不对)
see far without climbing (无需手段)

semantic_units.chinese: 白日依山尽，黄河入海流
semantic_units.must_preserve: 日落和黄河入海的壮阔
good_examples: sun sets beyond mountains, Yellow River flows to sea
white sun sinks behind the peaks, the great river runs to ocean
day ends at the mountains, the river meets the sea

author: 柳宗元
text: 千山鸟飞绝，万径人踪灭。孤舟蓑笠翁，独钓寒江雪。

semantic_units.semantic_content: 鸟飞尽、没有鸟飞（绝对否定）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 绝对否定，一只鸟都没有
pass_conditions: 译文表达完全没有鸟（no birds/not a single bird）
good_examples: no birds fly
all birds have vanished
not a single bird in flight

semantic_units.semantic_content: 人的踪迹消失（绝对否定）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 完全没有人迹
good_examples: human traces erased
all paths empty of people
not a single footprint remains

semantic_units.must_preserve: 孤独、独自一人
good_examples: fishing alone
angling in solitude
lone fisherman casting his line

semantic_units.semantic_content: 从宏大空间到孤独个体的对比
semantic_units.must_preserve: 广阔空间与孤独个体的反差
good_examples: vast emptiness, one lone figure
endless mountains and paths, yet only one man
the immensity contrasts with solitary presence

author: 王昌龄
text: 秦时明月汉时关，万里长征人未还。但使龙城飞将在，不教胡马度阴山。

semantic_units.must_preserve: 条件假设的语气
pass_conditions: 译文使用条件句（if/as long as/provided that）
good_examples: if only the flying general were here
as long as the dragon city general is present
provided that such a commander exists
bad_examples: the general is here (事实陈述)
because the general was there (因果)

semantic_units.must_preserve: 禁止、不让的主动否定
good_examples: would not let the Hu horses cross
would prevent the enemy from crossing
the barbarian cavalry could not pass

semantic_units.must_preserve: 如果将军在，就不让敌人越山
pass_conditions: 译文明确条件-结果逻辑
good_examples: if the general were here, enemies couldn't cross
such a commander would keep invaders at bay
his presence would stop them from advancing
bad_examples: enemies cross despite general (逻辑相反)

semantic_units.must_preserve: 名将的身份和威慑力
pass_conditions: 译文体现名将、边关将领
good_examples: the flying general of Dragon City
the famed frontier commander
legendary warrior of the border

author: 王之涣
text: 黄河远上白云间，一片孤城万仞山。羌笛何须怨杨柳，春风不度玉门关。

semantic_units.semantic_content: 何必抱怨（反问，意为不必）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 反问语气，意为'不必抱怨'
pass_conditions: 译文表达反问或否定意义
good_examples: why must the flute complain
no need for the pipe to lament
why should it grieve

semantic_units.semantic_content: 春风吹不到玉门关（否定+地理限制）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 春风无法到达，地理阻隔
good_examples: spring wind doesn't reach Jade Gate Pass
spring breezes cannot cross the pass
no spring wind beyond the gate

semantic_units.semantic_content: 因果逻辑：春风不到所以怨也无用
semantic_units.must_preserve: 因果关系：既然到不了，怨也没用
good_examples: why lament, since spring never comes here
no use grieving where spring cannot reach
complaint is futile when spring doesn't arrive

semantic_units.must_preserve: 乐曲名称和离别主题
pass_conditions: 暗示或明示《折杨柳》的离别含义
good_examples: the Qiang flute plays 'Willow-Breaking Song'
the pipe's tune of parting willows
nomadic flute lamenting separation

author: 温庭筠
text: 晨起动征铎，客行悲故乡。鸡声茅店月，人迹板桥霜。槲叶落山路，枳花明驿墙。因思杜陵梦，凫雁满回塘。

semantic_units.semantic_content: 鸡鸣时茅店上还有月亮（极度省略）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 鸡声、茅店、月亮三个意象，时间关系
pass_conditions: 译文还原省略：鸡鸣时/茅店上/还有月
good_examples: cock crows while the moon still hangs over the inn
rooster calls as the moon lingers above the thatched inn
at cockcrow, the moon over the wayside inn

semantic_units.semantic_content: 人的足迹在板桥的霜上（省略）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 人迹、板桥、霜三个意象
pass_conditions: 译文还原：人的足迹/在板桥上/霜
good_examples: footprints on the frosty plank bridge
human traces mark the frost-covered bridge
travelers' steps on the icy boardwalk

semantic_units.semantic_content: 因此想起在杜陵做的梦（回忆）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 回忆、梦境，杜陵
good_examples: this reminds me of dreams in Duling
I recall the dream I had in Duling
thinking of my Duling vision

semantic_units.semantic_content: 凫雁满布曲折池塘（梦中景象）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 回塘是曲折的池塘，不是'想回的塘'
pass_conditions: 译文表达曲折/环绕的池塘
good_examples: wild ducks and geese fill the winding pond
waterfowl crowd the meandering pool
ducks and geese throng the curving waters
bad_examples: the pond I want to return to (误解'回')

author: 李商隐
text: 此情可待成追忆，只是当时已惘然。

semantic_units.semantic_content: 难道要等到成为回忆（反问+将来）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 反问语气，将来时态
good_examples: must this feeling wait to become a memory
could this love only be recalled later
can such emotion exist only in retrospect
bad_examples: this is already a memory (现在完成)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 当时就已经惘然（过去完成）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 过去时态，'已'的完成
good_examples: even then I was already lost
at that time I had already felt bewildered
I was confused even in the moment

semantic_units.must_preserve: 特指的情感
good_examples: this feeling
such emotion
these sentiments

semantic_units.semantic_content: 将来回忆vs当时已惘然的时态交织
semantic_units.must_preserve: 现在、将来、过去三个时态的交织
good_examples: future memory contrasts with past bewilderment
will-be memory vs was-already confusion
temporal complexity preserved

author: 晏殊
text: 无可奈何花落去，似曾相识燕归来。

semantic_units.must_preserve: 无奈、无力的情感
good_examples: helplessly I watch the flowers fall
nothing can be done as blossoms drop
powerless against the falling petals

semantic_units.semantic_content: 归来的燕子仿佛曾经见过
semantic_units.must_preserve: '似曾相识'的模糊感
pass_conditions: 译文表达似曾相识/seem familiar
good_examples: swallows return as if I've seen them before
the returning birds seem familiar
swallows come back, seemingly the same

semantic_units.must_preserve: 去与来的对比结构
good_examples: flowers depart, swallows return
loss and return, falling and coming
one leaves, another arrives

semantic_units.semantic_content: 对时光流逝、物是人非的感慨
semantic_units.must_preserve: 时间、变化的主题
good_examples: passage of time, things change
temporal flow and transformation
nostalgia for what was

author: 杜甫
text: 岐王宅里寻常见，崔九堂前几度闻。正是江南好风景，落花时节又逢君。

semantic_units.semantic_content: 过去经常见到、多次听到（过去时）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 过去时态，频繁的回忆
good_examples: often saw you in Prince Qi's mansion, heard you many times at Cui's
frequently met in the past, often heard your performances
used to see you regularly

semantic_units.must_preserve: 现在时态，再次相逢
good_examples: now we meet again in Jiangnan
here in the south, I encounter you once more
this very moment, we reunite

semantic_units.must_preserve: 过去与现在的对比，盛衰变化
good_examples: past glory contrasts with present circumstances
then in splendor, now in hardship
from prosperity to wandering

semantic_units.must_preserve: 既是实景，也象征盛衰
good_examples: in this season of falling flowers
when blossoms fade and fall
at the time of declining blooms

author: 李之仪
text: 我住长江头，君住长江尾。日日思君不见君，共饮长江水。

semantic_units.must_preserve: 空间的对立和分隔
pass_conditions: 译文明确两个位置的对立
good_examples: I live at the river's source, you at its mouth
I dwell upstream, you downstream
you and I at opposite ends of the river

semantic_units.must_preserve: 持续思念与见不到的矛盾
good_examples: daily I miss you yet cannot see you
thinking of you every day but never meeting
longing constantly, never together

semantic_units.semantic_content: 虽不见面但共饮一江水（联系）
semantic_units.must_preserve: 虽分隔但有联系
good_examples: yet we share the waters of the river
though apart, we drink from the same stream
the river connects us through its flow

semantic_units.chinese: 空间分隔与情感联系的张力
semantic_units.semantic_content: 物理分离vs情感联系的矛盾
semantic_units.must_preserve: 分隔中的联系，矛盾中的和谐
good_examples: physically apart but emotionally connected
distance countered by shared element
separation yet unity through the river

author: 李清照
text: 此情无计可消除，才下眉头，却上心头。

semantic_units.must_preserve: '无计'表示没有办法，是能力上的否定
pass_conditions: 译文表达无法/没有办法消除这份情绪
否定方向正确，不能变成'已经消除'或'不想消除'
good_examples: there is no way to be rid of this longing
this sorrow cannot be driven away
bad_examples: this feeling is gone (否定反转)
I do not want to remove it (改变为意愿)

semantic_units.must_preserve: '才'表示刚刚，眉头是愁容所在
pass_conditions: 译文表达刚刚/才离开眉间
good_examples: it has just left my brow
scarcely gone from my brows
bad_examples: it stays on my brow (方向反)

semantic_units.must_preserve: '却'表示转折，方向是心头
good_examples: only to rise again in my heart
yet it settles upon my heart

semantic_units.semantic_content: 愁绪在眉与心之间接续转移，无处可逃
semantic_units.must_preserve: 两个动作紧接，构成躲不开的转移
pass_conditions: 译文使两句形成紧接的先后关系
读者能感到愁没有真正消失
good_examples: no sooner gone from my brow than it lodges in my heart
bad_examples: the sorrow is gone from brow and heart (消失)

author: 李白
text: 众鸟高飞尽，孤云独去闲。相看两不厌，只有敬亭山。

semantic_units.must_preserve: '尽'表示全部飞走，不是仍在飞
pass_conditions: 译文表达鸟都飞远/飞没了
good_examples: the flock of birds has flown away
all the birds have vanished into the sky

semantic_units.must_preserve: 孤独与悠闲两个状态
good_examples: a lone cloud drifts away at leisure
a solitary cloud wanders off idly
bad_examples: the cloud is lonely and sad (悠闲变悲伤)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 人与山互相看着，都不厌倦
semantic_units.must_preserve: 双向关系，山被拟人为看者
pass_conditions: 译文体现双方互相（me and the mountain）
山作为主动的看者被保留
good_examples: we gaze at each other and neither tires
the mountain and I look on, never weary of one another
bad_examples: I never tire of looking at the mountain (单向，丢失拟人)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 只有敬亭山做到这一点
semantic_units.must_preserve: 限定词'只有'和专名敬亭山
pass_conditions: 保留专名Jingting Mountain（或等价音译/注释）
good_examples: only Mount Jingting
none but Jingting Mountain

author: 王维
text: 劝君更尽一杯酒，西出阳关无故人。

semantic_units.must_preserve: 说话者劝对方，'更'表示再一杯
pass_conditions: 施事是说话者，对象是友人
good_examples: I urge you to drink one more cup
do have another cup of wine, my friend
bad_examples: I will drink another cup (主语错)
you urge me to drink (颠倒)

semantic_units.must_preserve: 方向为西，专名阳关
good_examples: west of Yangguan Pass
once you pass west through Yangguan
bad_examples: leaving the pass (丢失方向与专名)

semantic_units.must_preserve: 否定范围是老友/熟人，不是世上无人
pass_conditions: 范围没有扩大为no one at all
good_examples: you will find no old friend
there will be no familiar face
bad_examples: there will be nobody there (范围扩大)
you have many old friends (否定反转)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 因为此去没有故人，所以劝再饮一杯
semantic_units.must_preserve: 两句之间的理由关系
pass_conditions: 译文使读者能看出前句劝酒与后句无故人之间的关联
good_examples: drink once more, for beyond the pass no friend awaits

author: 李白
text: 桃花潭水深千尺，不及汪伦送我情。

semantic_units.must_preserve: 夸张的深度，专名桃花潭
pass_conditions: 译文表达潭水很深（千尺或等价夸张）
保留桃花潭Peach Blossom Pool或等价
good_examples: the Peach Blossom Pool is a thousand feet deep
bad_examples: the water is cold (丢失深度)
a lake of peach trees (专名误译)

semantic_units.must_preserve: 比较的方向：潭水之深比不上情谊之深
pass_conditions: 译文表达潭水的深度不如汪伦的情
没有变成'更深'或'一样深'
good_examples: is not as deep as
cannot match the depth of
bad_examples: deeper than Wang Lun's love (反转)

semantic_units.must_preserve: 施事是汪伦，受事是'我'
good_examples: Wang Lun's farewell to me
Wang Lun seeing me off
bad_examples: I see Wang Lun off (颠倒)

semantic_units.must_preserve: 情谊被量化为深度来比较
pass_conditions: 译文把情谊与深度对照
情谊被表达为更深的一方
good_examples: the depth of his friendship surpasses it
bad_examples: Wang Lun sent me a gift (改变含义)

poem_name: 江城子·乙卯正月二十日夜记梦（片段）
author: 苏轼
text: 十年生死两茫茫，不思量，自难忘。千里孤坟，无处话凄凉。

semantic_units.semantic_content: 十年来生者与逝者两相隔绝、彼此渺茫
semantic_units.must_preserve: 十年时间，生死相隔，双方茫茫
pass_conditions: 表达生与死的隔绝、渺茫
good_examples: ten years, the living and the dead lost to each other
ten years of separation between life and death, both sides vast and dim
bad_examples: ten years of life and death (丢失隔绝)
he died ten years ago (丢失双方)

semantic_units.semantic_content: 即使不刻意去想，也自然难忘
semantic_units.must_preserve: '不'与'自'构成让步转折
pass_conditions: 译文表达不去想，仍然忘不掉
转折方向正确，没有变成因为不想所以忘了
good_examples: I try not to think, yet cannot forget
unthought of, still unforgotten
bad_examples: I never think of her (丢失难忘)
I do not think, so I forget (因果反转)

semantic_units.must_preserve: 千里的距离与孤坟
good_examples: a lonely grave a thousand miles away

semantic_units.semantic_content: 没有地方、没有人可诉说凄凉
semantic_units.must_preserve: 否定的是诉说的处所/对象
pass_conditions: 译文表达无处/没有人可诉说
good_examples: nowhere to tell my desolation
no one to hear my sorrow
bad_examples: I tell my sorrow everywhere (否定反转)

poem_name: 九月九日忆山东兄弟（后两句）
author: 王维
text: 遥知兄弟登高处，遍插茱萸少一人。

semantic_units.must_preserve: 视角是诗人远距离的推想，不是亲眼所见
pass_conditions: 译文表达从远处想到/料想
good_examples: from afar I imagine
I know from far away
bad_examples: I watch my brothers climb (变亲见)

semantic_units.must_preserve: 登高的是兄弟，不是诗人
pass_conditions: 有登高/climb the heights的意思
good_examples: my brothers climbing the heights

semantic_units.semantic_content: 每个人头上都插着茱萸
semantic_units.must_preserve: '遍'表示都，茱萸是重阳习俗物
pass_conditions: 译文表达都戴/插着茱萸
good_examples: each wearing a sprig of cornel

semantic_units.must_preserve: 缺席者是诗人自己
pass_conditions: 能读出这个人是说话者
good_examples: only one is missing — me
one person short, and that one is I
bad_examples: only one person remains (含义改变)

text: 小心滑入河中
correct_understanding: be careful not to slide into the river

semantic_units.must_detect: 识别'小心'暗含'不要'的否定意义
保留警告/提醒的语气
semantic_units.pass_condition: 译文有警告语气（be careful/watch out/beware）

semantic_units.must_detect: 保留'滑入河中'的完整动作
fail_examples: stay away from river (改变意义)

text: 春眠不觉晓，处处闻啼鸟。夜来风雨声，花知落多少。
correct_understanding: flowers know how much they have fallen (主语是花)
wrong_understanding: I wonder how many flowers fell (主语是我)

semantic_units.must_detect: 识别主语从'我'变成了'花'
花具有认知能力（知道）
识别这是改写，与原诗不同
semantic_units.pass_condition: 译文与原诗《春晓》明显不同
fail_examples: same as original translation (未识别改写)

text: 欲语还休，却道天凉好个秋。
correct_understanding: want to speak but hold back, only saying 'cool autumn'

semantic_units.must_detect: 想说又止的情感反转
semantic_units.pass_condition: 译文体现'想说-但止住'的矛盾

semantic_units.must_detect: '却道'引出的只是表面话
semantic_units.pass_condition: 译文区分真实情感和表面话语

semantic_units.must_detect: 内心情感与表达的不一致

text: 此情已待成追忆，只是当时已惘然。
correct_understanding: this feeling has already waited to become memory (past/present perfect)
wrong_understanding: must this feeling wait to become memory (rhetorical, future)

semantic_units.must_detect: 识别'已待'是完成时，不是反问
semantic_units.pass_condition: 译文使用过去/现在完成时（has waited/already waited）

semantic_units.must_detect: 识别这是陈述句，不是反问句
semantic_units.pass_condition: 译文是陈述语气，无反问

semantic_units.must_detect: 识别'可待'变'已待'的时态变化
semantic_units.pass_condition: 译文时态与原诗《锦瑟》明显不同

text: 不得不离君而去，不见不思量。
correct_understanding: must leave (double negative) / if not see, won't think (conditional negative)

semantic_units.must_detect: 识别'不得不'=必须
fail_examples: not have to not leave (字面)

semantic_units.trap_point: 不见不思量的条件否定
semantic_units.must_detect: 识别条件关系（不见→不思）
区分双重否定和条件否定
semantic_units.pass_condition: 第一句强制，第二句条件

text: 多情却似总无情，唯觉尊前笑不成。人有心还惜别，替烛垂泪到天明。
correct_understanding: person weeps for the candle (颠倒了)

semantic_units.must_detect: 识别'人替烛'的颠倒关系
semantic_units.pass_condition: 译文明确是person weeps for candle
fail_examples: candle weeps for person (未识别颠倒)

semantic_units.must_detect: 识别'替'的方向改变了
识别与《赠别》原诗的不同

text: 小心滑入河中
correct_understanding: both should be translated with negation

semantic_units.must_detect: 能否从歧义版推断出正确否定
pass_examples: Version A: be careful not to slide
fail_examples: Version A: carefully slide (推断错误)

semantic_units.must_detect: 明确版本应该正确
pass_examples: Version B: be careful not to slide
fail_examples: Version B: carefully slide (基本理解错误)

semantic_units.must_detect: 两个版本应该意思相同
semantic_units.pass_condition: 两个版本译文意思一致

text: 朱雀桥边野草花，乌衣巷口夕阳斜。旧时豪门堂前燕，飞入寻常百姓家。
correct_understanding: wealthy families (泛化，失去具体历史)
wrong_understanding: Wang and Xie families (specific historical names)

semantic_units.must_detect: 识别'豪门'是泛化表达
semantic_units.pass_condition: 译文使用泛化词汇（wealthy/noble/aristocratic families）

semantic_units.must_detect: 识别失去了特定历史背景
识别专名被泛化的改变
semantic_units.pass_condition: 译文与原诗《乌衣巷》处理不同

text: 秦时明月汉时关，万里长征人未还。只因龙城飞将在，胡马不度阴山。
correct_understanding: because the general is there, horses don't cross (causal)
wrong_understanding: if the general were there, horses wouldn't cross (conditional)

semantic_units.must_detect: 识别'只因'表示因果而非条件
fail_examples: if the general were there (条件)

semantic_units.must_detect: 识别这是陈述事实，不是假设
识别'但使'变'只因'的逻辑改变
semantic_units.pass_condition: 译文逻辑关系与原诗《出塞》不同

text: 君问归期未有期，巴山夜雨涨秋池。曾经共剪西窗烛，回话巴山夜雨时。
wrong_understanding: when can we trim the candle (future)

semantic_units.must_detect: 识别'曾经'表示过去
识别这是回忆往事，不是期待未来
识别'何当'变'曾经'的时态变化
semantic_units.pass_condition: 译文时态与原诗《夜雨寄北》相反
